iterations: One prespecified method revision and independent evaluation; no repeated confirmation until favorable. Implementation corrections require documented reason and scope. New scientific revisions require a new version.
old_evidence: Retained; no replacement by favorable subsets. Existing natural cohorts remain previously explored.

g1.new_test: multi-draw geometry replication across rare/ordinary/frequent rates and sparse/full topology; same four design sentinels; fixed measurement budget

g2.new_test: Exact conditional stratified sign inference vs original probability-band certificate, per-environment exact Bonferroni test, log-OR Wald; existing CTMC profile results remain separate
g2.claim: Finite-sample sign safety under existing D3 proof; no finite magnitude interval guarantee and no claim that Fisher testing is novel

g3.new_test: Bounded selection bias sensitivity and fixed-cost unbiased calibration sign validation
g3.claim: Sign guarantee only inside the declared log-OR bias class; outside-class failures retained; X and XS separated

g4.new_test: Train-only predictive mixing of CTMC and unprojected saturated fusion; all baselines get identical data; direct original-record masking on both cancers
g4.claim: Prediction only; saturated mixture is not a recovered evolution generator; independent external replication remains absent

g5.new_test: Actual-spend matched acquisition comparisons on two cancers, with common feasible cost decided before reveal; all six original strategies retained
g5.claim: Predictive value and target-information acquisition; strategy aliases reported, no forced novelty; old natural incompatibility retained

acceptance.safety: Report all conditional cells, numerators/denominators and Wilson MC intervals; no overall average hides violations
acceptance.benefit: Paired effect and uncertainty from all fixed replicates; material positive effect needed, not just favorable mean
acceptance.novelty: Existing exact tests, fusion and CV are components, not newly invented methods
acceptance.unavailable_truth: Natural parameter coverage not scored; no external cohort is labeled NOT_TESTED, not failed efficacy

outputs: Each original g*/revision_r2 folder; old current delivery not overwritten before new review; physical PDF+SVG600dpi and user palette
